warrant: This check grades the numerical quantities named in output-contract.json on the independently materialized official operands. skimage.transform.hough_line_peaks (code/scikit-image/src/skimage/transform/hough_transform.py:8): stored geometry, sampling grids, interpolation order and boundary conventions define the transform; reordered sums and interpolation arithmetic may change low bits while shifted pixels or altered projection geometry change the output; skimage.transform.hough_circle_peaks (code/scikit-image/src/skimage/transform/hough_transform.py:305): stored geometry, sampling grids, interpolation order and boundary conventions define the transform; reordered sums and interpolation arithmetic may change low bits while shifted pixels or altered projection geometry change the output; skimage.draw.ellipse_perimeter (code/scikit-image/src/skimage/draw/draw.py:649): the rasterization geometry fixes physical pixel coordinates and coverage weights; coordinate-list order is arbitrary but weights must remain attached to their pixels. The named precision bounds retain exact discrete results and allow small floating rounding changes; a resolved one-percent gain error, a changed integer count or a changed physical region is not treated as numerical noise. The perturbation reaches only materialized call 2 (skimage.transform.hough_line); its CLI-recorded spread is sensitivity evidence for that workload, not a floor for every other call. No alternative-build or accelerator floor is claimed. The author finalized these source-linked bounds after reviewing the Docker calibration and accepting the explicitly documented scientific scope and remaining calibration limits.
